title: RoundRequest
description: What one round of a slice works from: its number, the slice, its interface files, the test files the builder may not change, its worktree, the builder's declaration, the practices, and where the rounds stood before it.

cutAs.description: The name the slice's worktrees are cut under: the slice's name in the workflow rounds, and in a wave the name forge gave the slice's attempt. Each worktree of the round is named after it.

interface.description: The interface files the slice builds against, relative to the slice's worktree.

fixed.description: The test files the slice's fails-first items name. The builder may not change them, and has none of their text.

cut.description: The slice's worktree as worktrees.cut made it.

folder.description: The worktree's folder, relative to the project.

commit.description: The commit the slice was cut from, in full.

practices.description: The practices files to read before writing, relative to the project, from forge's settings.

before.description: Where the rounds stood after the review before, as rounds.json gives it; null for round 1.
